# Waymark 0.3.2 preview

- Pets now shows observed souls gained in the current reader session, the number of affected pets, and the latest pickup. Expanded cards distinguish current and previous reader-session gains.
- The pet page's update time follows live soul/level observations while keeping the original login baseline separate.
- Reader feedback no longer disappears when another character is being followed or when the selected profile only has saved observations.
- Future-dated and stopped-reader heartbeats no longer validate an active character or farming session.
- Position diagnostics reject fixes from another map or an earlier reader session, with a specific explanation.

Verified with offline regression tests and an isolated example-profile UI. Existing progress and preferences are preserved. No game interaction or new recording was used, and no new dungeon/stronghold, inventory, resource or mid-session identity decoder is enabled. NotMeter passive coexistence from 0.3.1 is retained.
